map.输入每份净值 NAV、市价、年度分红、持有份额与杠杆比例，计算股息率、净值溢价/: Enter NAV per unit, market price, annual distribution, units held and the leverage ratio to compute dividend yield, NAV premium/discount, total return and levered return.
map.📖 查看「REITs收益计算 使用指南」: 📖 View the "REITs Return Calculator User Guide"
map.💡 股息率 = 年度分红 ÷ 市价；溢价/折价 =（市价 − NAV）÷ NAV: 💡 Dividend yield = annual distribution ÷ market price; premium/discount = (market price − NAV) ÷ NAV; levered return = unlevered return × (1 − leverage) + unlevered return × leverage ÷ net financing cost effect.
map.本工具按简化的融资成本（默认 4%）估算杠杆效应，实际利率以产品公告为准: Leverage is estimated at a simplified financing cost (4% by default); the actual rate follows the product announcement
map.REITs 分红可能包含本金返还，不全是投资收益: REITs distributions may include a return of capital and are not all investment income
map.溢价/折价受市场情绪与流动性影响，短期波动较大: Premium/discount is driven by sentiment and liquidity and can move sharply in the short term
map.结果仅供参考，不构成投资建议: Results are reference only and are not investment advice

map.与相对 NAV 溢价/折价。: and the premium or discount to NAV.
map.对比市价与净值判断高估还是低估。: Compare market price against NAV to judge whether it is over- or under-valued.
map.NAV 10 元、市价 9.5 元、每份分红 DPU 0.5 元、持有 1 万份: NAV 10 yuan, market price 9.5 yuan, DPU 0.5 yuan, 10,000 units held: dividend yield = 0.5/9.5 ≈ 5.26%, discount to NAV = (9.5−10)/10 = −4.76%, annual distribution = 0.5 × 10,000 = 5000 yuan.
map.年化总回报=股息率+市价变动率，若预期市价回到 NAV（涨 5.26%）则总回报: Annualized total return = dividend yield + price change; if the price returns to NAV (up 5.26%) total return is about 10.5%; with 40% leverage it is adjusted for a 4% financing cost.
map.折价好还是溢价好？: Is a discount or a premium better?
map.折价（市价<NAV）买入更安全、隐含回报高；高溢价需看底层资产质量是否支撑。: Buying at a discount (price below NAV) is safer with a higher implied return; a high premium must be checked against the quality of the underlying assets.
map.随 DPU 与市价波动，底层租金下滑或市价上涨都会降低股息率，需跟踪季报。: It moves with DPU and price: falling underlying rent or a rising price both lower the yield, so track the quarterly reports.
map.REITs收益测算工具，基于每份净值、市价、分红与杠杆，快速计算股息率、溢价折价: A REITs return tool: from NAV per unit, market price, distributions and leverage it computes dividend yield, premium/discount, annual total return and levered return, helping assess listed REITs.
